verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, bulk download, or exit path such as porting numbers out. It shows only a JSON API and MCP tools for pulling messages, calls and contacts, which are developer building blocks a user could assemble into an export, not an export capability. The only porting mention covers bringing a number in, not taking one out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
